chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Hassan al-Razi narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Ali al-Kufi narrated to us, saying: Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Hajjal narrated to us, from Ali ibn Aqaba ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he said:
"As if I see the Shia of Ali with the Qur'an in their hands, teaching people the newly arrived (or new converts)."

key_terms.الْمَثَانِي: The Recounted (a name for the Qur'an, referring to the repeated verses or the whole Qur'an)

ai.seo_question: What does the Imam mean by 'Al-Mathani' in the hands of the Shia?
ai.summary: In this narration from Al-Nu'mani, Imam al-Sadiq (as) foretells the era of the Qa'im, where the Shia will possess 'Al-Mathani' (commonly identified as Surah Al-Fatiha or the Qur'an in general) to instruct newcomers in the fundamentals of faith. This highlights the Shia's role as custodians of divine knowledge during the occultation and reappearance, emphasizing their intellectual and spiritual leadership in guiding the community. The reference to 'Al-Mathani' underscores the Qur'an's repetitive, clarifying nature as a tool for education and consolidation in the final age.
